notes: Round 3: full EfficientNetB0 backbone unfrozen (BatchNorm layers excepted), fine-tuned at 300x300 (up from 224x224), warm-started from round 2's weights. Best checkpoint saved at epoch 19 (val_accuracy 0.9893) before the training process was interrupted; evaluated and shipped as final. Evaluated on the dataset's held-out Testing split (1600 images, never seen during training).
